ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: There are three cups in the image: on the left is a cup filled with water, labeled 400 g; in the middle is an empty cup, labeled 100 g; on the right is a cup half full of water, and it asks to find its weight. According to the meaning of the problem, total weight = glass cup weight + water weight. The total weight of the full cup is 400 g, and the empty cup weighs 100 g, so the weight of the full cup of water itself is 400 - 100 = 300 g. The weight of the half-full cup of water is half of the full cup of water, namely 300 ÷ 2 = 150 g. Adding the weight of the empty glass cup 100 g, the total weight of the half-full cup is 100 + 150 = 250 g.
